Raj Patel: Hey team — just joined (I'm on Product infra). Trying to get access to a few secrets I need for my first-week tasks. What’s the current process for Vault/KMS access?

Evelyn (DevEx): Welcome Raj! :tada: For secrets we use HashiCorp Vault for app secrets and cloud KMS for long‑term keys. New hires need two things: membership in the `team-infra` SSO group (for read requests) and a secrets request created so security can approve.

Raj Patel: Got it. Where do I make that request? Any example of what to fill out?

Evelyn (DevEx): Use the internal Secrets Request form: https://console.redwood.internal/secrets/request — pick "Onboarding (new hire)". Minimal fields: path, purpose, justification, duration (if short‑lived). Example description: "Access to prod/db/conn for smoke tests during onboarding — expires in 2 weeks".

Raj Patel: Do we get long‑lived tokens or short TTLs? I want to run a small script that needs DB creds for a couple days.

Dina (Security): We avoid long‑lived static credentials. For onboarding we generally issue short‑lived credentials (Vault dynamic secrets or rotated KMS wrappers) with TTL <= 14 days. If you need automated rebuilds we can make a service role for you. If you need >14 days, include a justification and ops owner.

Raj Patel: Any CLI steps I should run to verify?

infra-bot: To check if your SSO group is active run: 

```
# check group membership
rslim auth whoami --show-groups
```

Evelyn (DevEx): Also you can test Vault read once approved: 

```
# example (after approval)
vault login -method=oidc
vault kv get secret/data/prod/db-conn
```

Raj Patel: I just submitted the form and attached the ticket id: SR-4827. Any ETA on approval?

Dina (Security): Thanks — I see SR-4827. For onboarding requests we usually triage within 4 business hours. I’ll route to the oncall approver.

Samuel (SRE): FYI if you need to run a one‑off job, I can create a scoped ephemeral token tied to your GH identity. Makes it easier than changing infra configs. Ping me with the ticket and the command you need to run.

Raj Patel: That would be great, Samuel — I need to run a data migration dry‑run tonight that touches the prod read replica.

Samuel (SRE): Cool. Please add tighter scope to the ticket (read only, replica hostnames) and set duration 6 hours. I’ll attach the ephemeral token and post the command snippet.

Dina (Security): Note on rotation: any credential we issue for onboarding will be added to the scheduled rotation workflow. If you later convert this to a service credential, we’ll require automated rotation and monitoring (onboarding exceptions are temporary).

Evelyn (DevEx): Quick checklist for you, Raj: 1) Confirm SSO group membership (run whoami). 2) Fill secret request and attach SR-4827. 3) Add scope & duration per Samuel’s note. 4) Expect approval in ~4 business hours. 5) Use Vault dynamic secrets or ephemeral token once provided.

Raj Patel: Awesome — thanks everyone. I updated SR-4827 with the read‑only scope and duration 6h.

infra-bot: Ticket SR-4827 status: APPROVER_ASSIGNED — Dina (Security). ETA 3h.

Dina (Security): Assigned and approved. Sam will post the token shortly. If anything needs escalation, @security-team.

Samuel (SRE): Posted ephemeral token instructions to SR-4827 and uploaded the runbook snippet. Command to export token locally: 

```
export REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN=eyJhbGci... (expires in 6h)
# then run your migration:
./scripts/migrate --read-replica --db-host replica01.prod
```

Raj Patel: Token worked, migration dry‑run completed. Thanks all! :raised_hands:

Evelyn (DevEx): Welcome aboard — reach out in #devex if you hit any more setup issues.

Raj Patel: Will do. One last Q — are there docs about key management (HSM vs cloud KMS) and where to store app keys?

Dina (Security): Yes, see Security runbook: https://docs.redwood.internal/security/secrets/kms-hsm.md — short summary: use cloud KMS for platform keys, HSM only for private certs/regulated keys, and never commit keys to repo. If you need help mapping your workload, we can schedule a 15m call.

Raj Patel: Thanks — schedule looks good. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
